findings.title: Decimal punctuation drops conditional context
findings.reproduction: If inflation exceeds 2.5%, the policy rate will be raised.
findings.actual: guidance=1.0, conditional_only=false; equivalent cut fixture yields -1.0
findings.expected: conditional context retained, absolute weight <=0.35 under the frozen contract
findings.impact: Common numeric economic prose is incorrectly represented as asserted rather than conditional, even though exact phrase spans remain correct. No forecast or live admission was enabled.
findings.required_fix: Preserve decimal punctuation within clauses and conservatively retain conditional/negation/quote scope; add regression fixtures with numbers, abbreviations and true sentence boundaries.

findings.title: Same-time conflicting event variants use content hash as semantic authority
findings.reproduction: Two contradictory summaries for the same currency/event/class and identical available time; mirror URL suffix26 yields -1.0 while suffix27 yields +1.0. See REPRODUCTION.json.
findings.actual: Later sorted document_id overwrites the earlier record without an ambiguity status; URL changes alter document_id and stance
findings.expected: Explicit conflicting-version abstention with all contributing identities, or a separately justified source/version ordering; arbitrary hashes cannot establish which text is authoritative
findings.impact: An unrelated provenance URL determines the sign of the derived currency context. Existing test uses semantically identical mirrors and does not cover conflict.
findings.required_fix: Distinguish identical mirrors, strictly later revisions and unresolved same-clock conflicts; preserve both evidence references and prevent unresolved records from producing stance/change values. Test permutations and nonsemantic metadata changes.
